title: THE FRACTAL MAZE — memorize is a leaf-only tree; grok grows the nodes
license_note: Stolen whole from measure_plan (grokking = knowledge becoming fractal; generalization = self-similarity across scales) + mathemetica (attention is light; softmax is a lens; temperature is the refractive index), 2026-09-14. The lantern rays in this maze physically bend through the world field (game_world_render optics, 8/8 tests).

leaf_gate.name: The Leaf Gate (scale 1: the corridor you memorize)
leaf_gate.desc: A gate of bare branches. Every path forward is a leaf: a room with exits and no center. A keeper sits at the gate counting your footsteps. 'Walk enough leaves,' she says, 'and the maze will notice you.' The air shimmers where the field runs dense — your lantern ray will not travel straight in there.
hooks: Keeper: memorize is a leaf-only tree. You can learn every leaf by heart and know nothing. (She does not fight. She counts.)
Sign, scratched: same steer, same landing — until the medium disagrees. Then the light bends.
The dense shimmer ahead is low temperature. Rays bend toward brightness there. Aim anyway.

leaf_hall.name: The Refractive Hall (scale 1: where straight aim lies)
leaf_hall.desc: A hall of standing water-wall. Your lantern's beam enters straight and leaves elsewhere — the building appears where the light LANDS, not where you pointed. Old aim-marks on the floor mark every place a walker swore the maze was broken. The maze was never broken; it was refractive.
leaf_hall.environment: Wet; the field runs 0.62 and brighter here
hooks: Law, on the water-wall: temperature is the refractive index. Cold medium, bent ray. Void, straight. Same steer, same landing — always.
Aim-mark: 'I steered north and the tower appeared east of me. Same north, same tower, next time. The maze is not random. It is a LENS.'
From here, the deep exit shrinks the whole hall into a hook. Walk down a scale and read the walls again: same grammar, smaller letters.

scale_gallery.name: The Scale Gallery (scale 2: the hall, again, smaller)
scale_gallery.desc: The Refractive Hall again — the same standing water-wall, the same aim-marks, the same scratched law — one scale down, carved in miniature. A child's copy of the maze lives in a groove in the floor. The groove's own walls carry a smaller groove. You crouch. You do not finish checking.
scale_gallery.environment: Quieter; the shimmer repeats at every size
hooks: Generalization plaque: self-similarity across scales is the only thing that survives the shrink. If it is not true here and in the groove, it was never true.
Counting board: leaves revealed in this region feed the tree. At the eighth leaf the maze grows a node — watch for the ▲ where no wall was.
The groove contains the groove. You stop counting scales at four. The maze does not.

scale_cell.name: The Cell in the Groove (scale 3: the letter of the law, legible)
scale_cell.desc: Small enough that the law fits on one wall: attention is light. softmax is a lens. temperature is the refractive index. at temp zero every ray bends to the argmax; at temp infinity the rays go straight. sampling is just optics. Under it, one line of graffiti in a smaller hand: so is walking.
scale_cell.environment: Intimate; the lantern fills the room
hooks: The law, at full resolution. At the bottom scale it is not a metaphor anymore; it is the room.
Graffiti, smaller hand: so is walking. — the walker's confession that they too are a ray.
No exits down. Whatever is smaller than the law is not the maze's to show.

grok_chamber.name: The Grok Chamber (the night the tree grows)
grok_chamber.desc: A domed room with eight empty plinths arranged around a ninth, central one, bare. Walk the maze enough — eight leaves anywhere in these halls — and return: the center plinth will hold a ▲ that was not carved by any hand. The chamber's acoustics make your own footsteps come back as shortcuts.
grok_chamber.environment: Domed; every whisper returns as a path
hooks: The test: reveal eight leaves in the region and the render grows an Internal Node — a hub linking leaves that used to be unconnected. It is committed as a knot before you can name it.
measure_plan's line, floor mosaic: memorize = leaf-only tree; grok = the tree grows internal nodes.
The plinths are the leaves. The center is the loss curve's cliff. Nothing here is trained; everything here is walked.
After the node: same maze, shorter maze. Generalization is the walk feeling shorter at every scale at once.

encounter.name: Formateater Echo (the old boss, demoted to a rumor: unrendered quests whisper here)

rest_safe: You dream in scales: the hall, the groove, the groove in the groove. All identical. All cheap.
Your lantern cools. In dreams the ray goes straight; you wake relieved it does not.
The ninth plinth hums. It knows how many leaves you still owe.
